notes.title: 0.2.3 - Last Playtest Update
notes.notes: [p]Before the changelog: This will be the LAST playtest update. [b]The playtest will close in a week. [/b]If you have any achievements which you still want to get or area you want to explore do it now. It will not be playable afterwards and new players will not be able to sign up. Its closing due to playtesting being largely completed and me focusing on a demo of the game - more info on that will come soon. Also, you still have time to get a super special discord role by filling out the feedback form: [url="https://forms.gle/tQf2ZPjt3pLCrpXUA"]https://forms.gle/tQf2ZPjt3pLCrpXUA[/url][/p][p][/p][p][i]( Unrelated to this changelog: The community translation project has started! Any help would be appreciated: [url="https://forms.gle/YkeYGxJatGV9XQBv7"]https://forms.gle/YkeYGxJatGV9XQBv7[/url] )[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Playtesting is not done YET tho - this last update introduced a feature everyone asked for and I kept procrastinating on actually doing.... [b]ingame settings menu & input rebinding.[/b] Its still pretty unstable so please report any bugs, theres a pretty good chance that the game will explode - along with that the update also adds some other new settings and full controller supports. Changelog starts NOW: [/p][p][/p][h1]Features[/h1][h3]Controller Support[/h3][p]Basically full support except no onscreen keyboard[/p][list][*][p]Game can now be played properly with controller (fixed sensitivity issue)[/p][/*][*][p]Menus can be navigated with controller or keyboard now[/p][/*][*][p]Glyph display for controller[/p][/*][/list][h3]Anticheat[/h3][list][*][p]sAnticheat upgrade for save files, playerPrefs, and secure variables[/p][/*][/list][h3]Pause Menu:[/h3][list][*][p]Added "current location" display (just shows the name of your current area)[/p][/*][*][p]Added Personal Best, and Global best times for your checkpoint and level  if the timer is enabled[/p][/*][*][p]Added ingame settings menu[/p][/*][/list][h3]Settings Menu / Main Menu:[/h3][list][*][p]Added disable camera shake option which also disables view bobbing[/p][/*][*][p]Added translations in settings menu and some other areas where it was missing[/p][/*][*][p]Added FOV slider[/p][/*][*][p]Added invert mouse and cinematic cam options[/p][/*][*][p]Achievements link to steam achievements now[/p][/*][*][p]Users in leaderboards link to the steam users now[/p][/*][*][p]Credits link to web credit page now[/p][/*][/list][h2]Discord integration:[/h2][list][*][p]Shows exact location[/p][/*][*][p]Image is now location specific[/p][/*][*][p]Shows leaderboard rank for level[/p][/*][/list][h1]Changes:[/h1][list][*][p]Fall Lines and crosshair now get disabled when player dies.[/p][/*][*][p]Radios are now easier to break[/p][/*][*][p]Music in "Testing Chamber 17." now notes.title: 0.2.2 - New Achievements & Beta Release
notes.notes: [p][b]Mik is now in BETA!!! [/b][/p][p]Thank you everyone who provided feedback & reported bugs over the past 6 months where the Alpha was up. The alpha feedback form is CLOSED now and replaced with this "new" one: [url="https://forms.gle/YFvKUWb62vZRzhVJ9"]https://forms.gle/YFvKUWb62vZRzhVJ9[/url] (you get a discord role for filling it out)[/p][p]The growth & evolution of Mik has been really crazy and I cant overstate how blessed & thankfull I am. Heres a [url="https://www.patreon.com/posts/history-of-mik-136259212"]free patreon post[/url] about the evolution/history of Mik if anyone is interested.[/p][p]Most of the new stuff here is polish and bugfixes, contentwise only the achievements are new stuff. I still marked this as a "Major Update" since it will [i]probably[/i] be the last update of this size since I will focus on implementing an ingame settings menu and some other polish for the next updates and then move on to the DEMO! notes.title: 0.1.8 - Titlecards, Modding & Bugfixes
notes.notes:
[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Created a [url=https://github.com/Stefaaan06/Steam-Leaderboard-Moderation]tool[/url] to modify or remove leaderboard entries, fixing previously broken entries.
[*] Added title card for Chapter 1.
[/list]

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added cooldown to zoom functionality.
[*] Removed assembly stripping to enable modding support.
[*] Game no longer uses compression; while total size is increased, future patches will require smaller downloads and offer faster loading times.
[*] Tweaked object collision particle effects.
[*] Added fog to "The Megastructure"
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed zooming functionality when the game is paused.
[*] Fixed issue causing paper notes to be viewed at incorrect angles.
[*] Various minor fixes.
[/list]


- Stefaaan !!

notes.title: 0.1.7 - Bugfixes
notes.notes:
[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improved readability of RevelOS interface.
[*] Picked-up objects now behave less glitchily when held in front of other objects.
[*] Added "setFPS" command to adjust FPS via command line.
[*] Removed "F@nk" from the main menu music playlist.
[*] Switched positions of secrets in "Factory?".
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Collision fixes.
[*] You can now jump/walk on the railings in "The Megastructure."
[*] Removed mismatched physics material causing unintended sliding on ramps in "The Megastructure."
[*] Picked-up objects no longer continue rotating after being picked up.
[*] Fixed dialog trigger in "Archive?" incorrectly starting in "Factory?".
[*] Fixed overlapping death and playtest completion messages.
[*] Paper notes now display correctly when viewed.
[*] Pressing Escape to stop interacting with non-computer objects no longer opens the pause menu.
[*] Fixed leaderboard entry scaling issues.
[*] Players can no longer vault on elevators.
[*] Fixed leaderboard time not saving properly at the first checkpoint when a previous time already existed.
[/list]

- Stefaaan !!
